# Open Fixture Library fixtures

Fixture definitions from the [Open Fixture Library](https://open-fixture-library.org),
used as they are by `tests/unit/ofl.test.js`. Each file is named
`<manufacturer>_<fixture>.json` after its key in the library.

| File | Fixture | Authors |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `american-dj_mega-bar-rgba.json` | American DJ Mega Bar RGBA | Anonymous |
| `cameo_root-par-6.json` | Cameo ROOT PAR 6 | Goetz, JonahKr |
| `showtec_pixel-bar-12-mkii.json` | Showtec Pixel Bar 12 MKII | Felix Edelmann |
| `stairville_led-bar-240-8.json` | Stairville LED Bar 240/8 | kiki |
| `varytec_giga-bar-frost-pix-8-rgb.json` | Varytec Giga Bar Frost Pix 8 RGB | Luke Nelson |
